PluginData.Author: Viktor
PluginData.Tooltip: Stops the simulation of grids if far away from all online players
PluginData.Description:
Concealment cuts dedicated server load by concealing grid groups that are far from every online player. Concealed grids stop simulating, so their timers, programmable blocks and thrusters pause. They are revealed again when a player comes near.
Admins set the conceal and reveal distances and scan intervals, the block subtypes that keep a grid group revealed, and whether pirate grids may be concealed. Active refineries and assemblers follow a production mode: Off keeps them revealed, Conceal pauses them, and Approximate lets them catch up at boosted speed after they are revealed. Dynamic rules skip selected block updates while no matching characters or grids are nearby. An optional remote control action keeps a grid revealed for one conceal interval.
Commands: !conceal run, !conceal reveal, !conceal reveal all, !conceal on and !conceal off.
Functionality is inspired by and reimplements the original Torch plugin Concealment by TorchAPI: https://github.com/TorchAPI/Concealment
